items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He and I were in school together. He was a bad, bad tenor player, all the time. He was breaking this record. I said, “I’m not – no, no.” He said, “Come on.”

ctx.x: [does not recall how long she worked there.]
But before that we also forgot Dexter Gordon.
He and I were in school together. He was a bad, bad tenor player, all the time. He was breaking this record. I said, “I’m not – no, no.” He said, “Come on.”
